name: clawpyter
//: yjs is a peer/optional runtime dependency. The plugin loads and runs without it (collab falls back silently; Contents-API path). End users that want Y.js CRDT co-editing install yjs themselves (peer dep with optional=true), but we ALSO declare it as a devDependency so `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` works out of the box after `npm install` — collab-client.ts imports from yjs/... and a missing module fails the typecheck. The two declarations are consistent: both resolve to a 13.x major; runtime users on a peer-clean machine still skip it because npm install --omit=dev drops devDependencies.
